# `kb` command

Search and manage the knowledge packs.

```bash
fobis kb <subcommand> [options]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Models, knowledge and agents](/cookbook/ai-setup).

<!-- cli:begin -->
<!-- generated by docs/scripts/gen_cli_reference.py from the command line: do not edit -->

## All options

### `fobis kb add`

Install an already built pack.

Arguments: `PATH`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` |  |  | Use the project's packs (.fobis/kb) instead of the user's. |

### `fobis kb build`

Build a pack from markdown and install it (user packs by default).

Arguments: `SOURCES...`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--name` | TEXT |  | Pack name (lower case, digits, '-'). |
| `--license` | TEXT |  | Licence of the content (SPDX id). |
| `--title` | TEXT |  | One-line description. |
| `--attribution` | TEXT |  | Author / source to credit. |
| `--notice` | TEXT |  | NOTICE file to include. |
| `--private` |  |  | Build without licence: for your own use only. |
| `--out` | TEXT |  | Output directory [default: the user or project pack dir]. |
| `--project` |  |  | Use the project's packs (.fobis/kb) instead of the user's. |

### `fobis kb list`

List the installed packs (shipped, user, project).

No options.

### `fobis kb notice`

Print a pack's licence, attribution and NOTICE.

Arguments: `NAME`

No options.

### `fobis kb remove`

Remove a user (or project) pack; shipped packs cannot be removed.

Arguments: `NAME`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--project` |  |  | Use the project's packs (.fobis/kb) instead of the user's. |

### `fobis kb search`

Find the sections that best match QUERY.

Arguments: `QUERY`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--pack`, `-p` | TEXT |  | Search only these packs (repeatable). |
| `-k` | INTEGER | `5` | Number of results. |
| `--json` |  |  | Machine-readable output. |

### `fobis kb show`

Print a section (and optionally its neighbours).

Arguments: `CHUNK_ID`

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--context`, `-C` | INTEGER | `0` | Also show N neighbouring sections. |

<!-- cli:end -->
